patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

BookYourData and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than ZoomInfo's shape. Choose ZoomInfo only if your buying job matches “Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, in” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; ZoomInfo leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and ZoomInfo share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; ZoomInfo is Enterprise go-to-market intelligence platform for B2B contact/company data, enrichment, intent, and Copilot workflows — custom-quote packagi.
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs ZoomInfo-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; ZoomInfo — Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — BookYourData: —; ZoomInfo: Main platform seat prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Credit consumption on export (CSV/CRM/API) requires ongoing governance.
